metadata.name: mercado
metadata.description: MERCADO MIGORY trading program (stages 1-3 and 5: listings, offers, family offers, swaps)

instructions.name: accept_family_offer
docs: Stage 3: sell one item into a family offer, with its proof from the published snapshot.

accounts.name: seller
docs: The item's owner.

accounts.name: listing
docs: The seller's Mercado listing of this item, if it is listed: closed in the same transaction.

instructions.name: accept_offer
docs: The owner sells one item into an offer, receiving at least `min_receive`. A Mercado listing of the item is
closed in the same transaction. Remaining accounts: the royalty creators, writable, in the plugin's order.

accounts.name: seller
docs: The item's owner.

accounts.name: listing
docs: The seller's Mercado listing of this item, if it is listed: closed in the same transaction.

instructions.name: accept_swap
docs: Stage 5: the lister accepts; items move both ways in one transaction.

instructions.name: admin_update
docs: Admin (delayed route): fee wallet, collections, creators, royalty, keys.

instructions.name: buy
docs: Buy a listed item. Remaining accounts: the royalty creators, writable, in the plugin's order.

accounts.name: collection
docs: buy also checks the item is still in it; stage 5 final re-check).

instructions.name: cancel_listing
docs: The seller cancels the listing `listing_id`. Never blocked by pause, stages or collection removal.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The seller (cancel) or anyone (close stale). Pays any Core rent changes.

accounts.name: collection
docs: item itself, so an item moved to another collection, or out of every collection, can still be released
(stage 5 re-check); unused for an item in no collection or one that is gone.

instructions.name: cancel_offer
docs: The bidder takes back every unused lamport. Never blocked by pause, stages or collection removal.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The bidder (cancel) or anyone (after expiry).

instructions.name: close_expired_offer
docs: Anyone closes an expired offer; the SOL and rent go only to the bidder.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The bidder (cancel) or anyone (after expiry).

instructions.name: close_stale_listing
docs: Anyone closes a listing that can't sell (item moved, or no longer frozen with both of Mercado's delegates).

accounts.name: signer
docs: The seller (cancel) or anyone (close stale). Pays any Core rent changes.

accounts.name: collection
docs: item itself, so an item moved to another collection, or out of every collection, can still be released
(stage 5 re-check); unused for an item in no collection or one that is gone.

instructions.name: end_swap
docs: Stage 5: the offerer cancels, the lister declines, or anyone after expiry; refunds once, releases items.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The offerer (cancel), the lister (decline), or anyone once the offer has expired. Pays any Core rent change.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Creates Config. Only the program's upgrade authority can call it.

accounts.name: program
docs: Only the program's upgrade authority can create Config, so nobody can front-run it.

instructions.name: list
docs: List an item at a fixed price. Freezes it in the seller's wallet.

accounts.name: lock
docs: Never closed; its one-time rent is paid by the first holder ever to lock the item.

instructions.name: make_family_offer
docs: Stage 3: bid `price` for each of 1 to 10 items of one family, pinned to this registry version's list.

instructions.name: make_offer
docs: Stage 2. Bid `price` SOL for each of `quantity` items: one item (kind 1, quantity 1) or any item of one
allowed collection (kind 2, 1 to 10). The SOL moves into the Offer; expiry at most 7 days away.
`nonce`: chosen by the bidder (random); fixes the Offer's address together with the bidder.

instructions.name: make_swap_offer
docs: Stage 5: offer 1 to MAX_SWAP_ITEMS items (remaining accounts), plus optional SOL, for one listing.

accounts.name: listing
docs: The listing asked for: named by its item, and its ID must be the one the offerer saw.

accounts.name: listed_asset
docs: listing that can never fill (stage 5 review).

instructions.name: publish_registry
docs: Stage 3, admin: publish one version of the family lists (one Merkle root per family). Never changed after.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The admin (on mainnet the Squads vault, through the 24-hour delayed route). Pays the account's rent.

instructions.name: release_swap_items
docs: Stage 5, anyone: release more items of an ended swap offer; the account closes after the last.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The offerer (cancel), the lister (decline), or anyone once the offer has expired. Pays any Core rent change.

instructions.name: set_fees
docs: Daily key or admin: the fee and the "$50 line" together, within the caps.

instructions.name: set_paused
docs: Pause: daily key or admin. Unpause: admin.

instructions.name: set_stages
docs: Switch stages off (daily key or admin) or on (admin).

errors.name: BadOfferKind

errors.name: OfferNotExpired

errors.name: OfferFilled

errors.name: NotOfferTarget

errors.name: BelowMinimum

errors.name: OwnItem

errors.name: NotInFamily

errors.name: ProofRequired

errors.name: ProofTooLong

errors.name: ListingChanged

fields.name: authority_bump
docs: Bump of the program authority PDA (`["authority"]`) that holds Mercado's Freeze and Transfer Delegates.

fields.name: daily_key
docs: MIGORY's daily key: fee updates within the caps, pause, switching stages off. Immediate.

fields.name: admin
docs: The delayed route: on mainnet the Squads vault (24-hour time lock, only the backup key can approve).
Everything sensitive: fee wallet, collections, creators, keys, switching stages on, unpausing.

fields.name: fee_lamports
docs: The "$1" fee, in lamports.

fields.name: line_lamports
docs: The "$50 line": sales priced below it pay no fee.

fields.name: creators
docs: MIGORY's published creators. Royalty plugins naming anyone else are refused.

fields.name: royalty_bps
docs: Required total royalty, in basis points (500 = 5%).

types.name: FamilyRoot
docs: One family's list in a registry version: the Merkle root of its items, and how many there are.

fields.name: listing_id
docs: Taken from Config; never reused.

fields.name: price
docs: 0 for a swaps-only listing (which can't be bought).

fields.name: agreed_fee
docs: The fee the seller agreed to when listing (0 if under the line). A sale charges the lower of this and today's.

types.name: Lock
docs: Per-item record, never closed, so The Arena can see every listing, however short (design: The Arena).

fields.name: times_locked
docs: Only ever goes up.

fields.name: active_kind
docs: The order using the item right now (ORDER_NONE if free).

fields.name: active_slot
docs: Slot in `periods` of the active order's period.

fields.name: next_slot
docs: Slot the next period will be written to (a ring of LOCK_PERIODS).

fields.name: owner
docs: Owner of the item when it was locked.

fields.name: kind
docs: ORDER_LISTING or ORDER_SWAP (0 = unused slot).

fields.name: closed_at
docs: 0 while still open.

fields.name: expires_at
docs: For swaps: the offer's expiry. The Arena treats the period as ended at expiry even if cleanup comes later.

types.name: Offer
docs: A bid in SOL (stage 2). The bid's SOL sits in this account, above its rent, until a fill pays a seller or the
bidder takes it back: the bidder can cancel at any time, and anyone can close it after expiry. Either way the SOL
and the rent only ever go to the bidder.

fields.name: offer_id
docs: Taken from Config; never reused.

fields.name: nonce
docs: Chosen by the bidder's browser (random); with the bidder it fixes the Offer's address, so two people bidding at
the same moment never compete for the next Config number (review finding H-1, 23 November 2026).

fields.name: kind
docs: OFFER_ITEM or OFFER_COLLECTION.

fields.name: target
docs: The item (OFFER_ITEM) or the collection (OFFER_COLLECTION).

fields.name: collection
docs: The collection the item must belong to (for OFFER_ITEM, the item's collection when the offer was made).

fields.name: price
docs: Price for each item, in lamports.

fields.name: expires_at
docs: A fill at or after this time is refused.

fields.name: registry_version
docs: Stage 3 (family and trait offers): registry version, Merkle root and trait the offer is pinned to. Zero here.

fields.name: filled_items
docs: Items already bought, so the same item can never fill an offer twice. Space for `quantity` items is paid
up front by the bidder.

fields.name: listing_id
docs: The seller's listing that closed with this fill, if the item was listed.

types.name: Registry
docs: Stage 3: one published version of the family lists (design: "Offer on a family or a trait", families only by
MIGORY's decision of 23 November 2026). Created once by the admin (on mainnet the 24-hour delayed route) and never
changed: a new list is a new version, and every family offer stays pinned to the version and root it was made with.

fields.name: collection
docs: The collection every listed item belongs to.

fields.name: snapshot_hash
docs: sha256 of the published snapshot file, so anyone can check the file the roots came from.

types.name: Swap
docs: Stage 5: an offer of 1 to MAX_SWAP_ITEMS items, plus optional SOL, for one listed item. The SOL on top and the
offerer's $1 sit in this account above its rent; the offered items stay frozen in the offerer's wallet.

fields.name: swap_id
docs: Taken from Config; never reused.

fields.name: nonce
docs: Chosen by the offerer's browser (random); with the offerer it fixes the Swap's address (as Offer.nonce).

fields.name: lister
docs: The listing's seller when the offer was made; may decline.

fields.name: listing_id
docs: The listing the offer is for. Any sale, cancel, swap or relist ends that listing, so the offer can't fill.

fields.name: sol_on_top
docs: SOL added on top by the offerer (0, or at least 0.01 SOL), held here.

fields.name: fee_held
docs: The offerer's $1, held here until the swap is accepted (fee wallet) or ends (back to the offerer).

fields.name: state
docs: SWAP_OPEN or SWAP_ENDED (an accepted swap's account is closed).

fields.name: released
docs: Items released after the offer ended, one bit per item.

fields.name: fees
docs: Both $1 fees.

fields.name: reason
docs: 1 cancelled by the offerer, 2 declined by the lister, 3 closed after expiry.
